risks.risk: The keyboard may not power on or produce sound.
risks.proof: A video showing the keyboard powered on and playing a scale or demo song.

risks.risk: Individual keys or buttons may be unresponsive or 'dead'.
risks.proof: A video of a chromatic scale being played across all keys.

risks.risk: The LCD screen may be cracked or have dead pixels.
risks.proof: A clear, close-up photo of the screen while the unit is powered on.

risks.risk: The internal batteries may be dead or the battery compartment damaged.
risks.proof: A photo of the battery compartment and a video showing the unit running on battery power.
risks.if_unproven: as requiring a constant power source

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the keyboard powered on and playing a full scale to test all keys.
Photo of the LCD screen while the unit is on.
Photo of the battery compartment and the power adapter.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
